text_block_list.text:
As an assignment for their nutrition 
class, several classes had joined together 
to make original sweets.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It must work as both a sweet treat and a 
nutritious meal. Unite around this single 
goal and let's make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, when Durandal says "unity," it makes 
her sound so cool, like a knight 
commander!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, we're making sweets today, so how 
about... the Knights of Pâtissières, or 
something...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It's a rather vague name for an order of 
knights, but... oh well. Let's do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-hmmm~♪ I'd be sooo happy if it 
turns out delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...You're quite skilled at that. Even an 
amateur like me can see how fine the foam 
is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The fruit sauce seems to be coming along 
nicely too. It smells wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The recipe said it'd be good to add the 
fruit from fruit liqueur, so I tossed some 
in♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My topping prep is going smoothly too. 
Once it's done baking, it's time to 
decorate!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. The Pâtissière Knights are making 
great strides, aren't they~?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Why... Why did it turn out like this...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Durandal, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Looks like the cream decoration 
is hitting a bit of a rough patch...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's totally fine! The vibe will get 
the point across! Look, it's that thing, 
right? Durandal-chan's, um, um――"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it! This is a holy sword, right? 
Yeah, yeah, it's super cool♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ... I was supposed to be... your master.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...I completely underestimated my own 
clumsiness... Even if it's nutritionally 
sound, the appearance is a total 
disaster..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Th-Then how about this! What if 
we just pulled the camera back and shot it 
from afar...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer watching over Durandal-chan as 
she trains! ...Or something like that, 
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in that case, let's make it on an even 
bigger scale and pile some cream over here 
too...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look! You can be the Trainer cheering on 
Durandal's glorious moment from the 
stands! Doesn't that sound great?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I can't even see where Milady is 
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's okay, Durandal-chan! Cooking is, 
well, you know, all about the total 
package!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Total...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Even if it looks a bit off, 
you make up for it with massive sincerity! 
Ah, or in Durandal-chan's case, loyalty.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Loyalty... on a grand scale... Heh, 
hehehe... Yes, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: D-Durandal-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My loyalty cannot be expressed with 
delicate crafting! It must be grander! 
Broader! Truly boundless!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Let's make up for the missing 
ingredients! I'm making more cream, so 
give me a hand!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ I can't wait to see how it turns 
out.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Dants-san, please color the cream with 
food coloring!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, things are getting seriously out 
of hand, aren't they~?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...And so, please give this a taste test.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Titled: "The Glory We Built Together 
Resounds Across the World"... I went all 
out with grand scale!
choice_data_list: This is a sweet?! Not a map?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
For the glory of my master surely shall 
not be confined to this nation alone.
choice_data_list:
Finishing off this huge amount is gonna 
take some real momentum...

Finishing off this huge amount is gonna 
take some real momentum...

You made something incredible... I feel 
like I've discovered a whole new frontier.

You made something incredible... I feel 
like a whole new world is opening up!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
For the glory of my master surely shall 
not be confined to this nation alone.

take some real momentum...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have full confidence in its flavor and 
the loyalty poured into it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Just like a king advancing, 
let's push forward fearlessly with all our 
might!
choice_data_list: J-Just went at it with full momentum...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Let us finish eating in one smooth, 
flowing motion! Our glory lies just 
beyond!

It was delicious, no doubt, but as 
expected, being the taste tester left me 
with an upset stomach through the next 
day.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It went through many twists and turns to 
reach this form. Its great size is due to 
holding all those stories within.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, this is the epic poem of the 
PÃ¢tissiÃ¨re Knight Order. Now, let us 
draw back the curtain on the prologue!
choice_data_list:
Whoa... It's delicious...! But there's so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please, savor my loyalty to your heart's 
content!

Later, a nutrition instructor who had 
tried the same dish told me, "You 
certainly have a student with interesting 
ideas."
